source_clause: HVS2. For Multi-Level Heated/Vented seats, a press of the vented seat button opens popup and turns the seat on HI , the soft button highlights blue and control displays a large fan, HI and/or 3 LEDs. The next button press sets the seat to MED, button remains highlighted and displays a medium fan, MED and/or 2 LEDs. The third button press sets the seat to LO, button remains highlighted and displays a small fan, LO and/or 1 LED. The next press, turns the vented seat OFF, the button is no longer highlighted and no arrows are shown.
reasoning: 驗證目標：11.2（HVS2）以四句定出 Multi-Level 通風座椅之四段按壓循環及其藍色高亮與風扇指示，四個 037 leaf 逐句對應。關鍵情境條件：同 11.1（第八軸之 Multi-Level 值）；依 **R-C34** 四個介面型軸中三者暴露 → 補，第十二軸亦補。為什麼這樣切：與 11.1 為同型之四段循環，惟其可觀察量（藍色、風扇大小、LED 數）與加熱側完全不同，故不因形態相同而合併（§8.2 單位歸 037）。刻意略過：**`055-01` 之 popup 內容不驗**（同 11.1，DR #11）；條文之「no arrows are shown」與加熱側之「3 arrows are shown」不一致，**照錄各自之字面**，不推斷孰為筆誤（§8.4.1）。

distinguishing_axis.axis: 章之別（ch11 vs ch12）；本對之實質差異為 `opens popup` 片語
distinguishing_axis.delta: `11.2` 之首句有 `opens popup` 而 `12.2` 無，其餘三段逐字相同，三對 TC 三欄等價（`055-02`～`055-04` ↔ `068-02`～`068-04`）。處置同 `11.1`↔`12.1`：兩份保留、`duplicate_of` 不填、等價記於 `equivalent_tc_pairs`

interface_axis_review.observable_interface: comfort section 之通風座椅軟鍵與其指示
interface_axis_review.axis_9: 暴露 → 全數補 —— 可觀察量在 head unit 之 comfort section（6.3）
interface_axis_review.axis_12: **暴露 → 全數補（本組首次以排除式使用第十二軸）** —— 座椅控制位於 comfort category 之 Seats 分頁，2.1 使 tabs 於僅前排氣候之車輛不顯示
interface_axis_review.axis_13: 暴露 → 全數補（出處 2.14 C15，跨節取據 R-C29）
interface_axis_review.emea_ics: **排除補並逐條答（R-C36-1）** —— 逐條之答皆為 `no`：ch16 無加熱／通風座椅之行為節（僅 16.16 之座椅 off icon，其 leaf 已停下），見 DR #41 之形態

tcs.tc_title: A press of the vented seat button opens the popup and sets HI
tcs.test_item:
For Multi-Level Heated/Vented seats, a press of the vented seat button opens popup and turns the seat on HI , the soft button highlights blue and control displays a large fan, HI and/or 3 LEDs.

(The vehicle has Multi-Level Heated/Vented seats; The vehicle is not a front-climate-only vehicle; read the vented seat button and its control)
tcs.pre_conditions:
1. [spec-derived] The vehicle has Multi-Level Heated/Vented seats (11.1)
2. [spec-derived] The vehicle does not have 3 knob HVAC controls with ICS, for which no HVAC screens or pop ups are displayed (2.14)
3. [spec-derived] The vehicle is not an EMEA ICS vehicle, whose climate interface is specified separately in chapter 16 (16.2)
4. [spec-derived] The vehicle is not configured with a non-foldable secondary lower screen containing comfort information, for which the comfort section is removed from the head unit (6.3)
5. [spec-derived] The vehicle is not a front-climate-only vehicle, for which the comfort tabs are not displayed (2.1)
tcs.test_procedure:
1. Press the vented seat button in the comfort section
2. Read the vented seat button and its control
tcs.expected_result:
1. The heated/vented seat popup opens
2. The vented seat is on HI, the button is highlighted blue and the control displays a large fan, HI and/or 3 LEDs

emea_ics_review.ch16_sentence: ch16 十八節中僅 `16.16`（ICE15）提及座椅圖示（「Off icon of seats will depend on system configuration」，其 leaf `122-02` 已停下），**無一節定義加熱／通風座椅、加熱方向盤或座椅分區之按壓循環、層級呈現或其 popup**；故本條之 EMEA 排除**無 ch16 對造句可依**，屬 R-C36-1 之過嚴側（同 DR #41 之形態）

tcs.test_item_authored: The system shall on a press of the vented seat button open the popup and turn the seat on HI, with the soft button highlighted blue and the control displaying a large fan, HI and/or 3 LEDs
